“Absorb what is useful, reject what is useless and add
is how I lead a Scrumptious life.
For this month, I would love you to do the following exercise EVERY DAY!!! (It becomes
a habit after 21-28 days of doing something, and we no longer have to use our
conscious brain to do this task.) Hello neural pathways!
Bragging is something that most of us have been taught is “not acceptable”. It is
boastful to take pride in your qualities, possessions or accomplishments.
Celebrating yourself also comes with quite a negative connotation.
“You are too big for your own shoes”
I am sure you have quite a few of your own that you heard growing up or even have
said a few to yourself or your kids, nephews, or co-workers!
